decisions.reason: Because this compilation CD is close to the firm's core curation and reissue knowledge and was still given its own page after launch, management would likely keep it unless demand has clearly faded.

An illustrated music release series builds directly on the firm's existing editorial and specialist music capabilities, so high absorptive capacity and evidence of continued promotion support keeping it.

A reissued jazz vinyl LP fits the firm's established reissue and physical-format expertise well, making it a product the firm can understand and refine, though niche demand keeps some risk of withdrawal.

While a multi-disc box set is related to the firm's capabilities, it is a costlier niche format with likely limited-run economics, so management would be slightly more likely to redeploy resources after the initial market test.
This compilation CD is related to the core business but had the weakest visible market support, so despite the firm's relevant knowledge, management would likely judge it not strong enough to retain.
